title: AI Chatbot Development Cost in India
seoTitle: AI Chatbot Development Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What an AI chatbot trained on your documents costs in India: website and WhatsApp bots, human handover, running costs. Cost bands, timelines and drivers.
summary: An AI chatbot trained on your own documents typically costs ₹4 lakh to ₹10 lakh for an internal or website assistant on one document set, ₹10 lakh to ₹25 lakh for a customer-facing bot on website and WhatsApp with handover to staff and system integrations, plus monthly running costs for the model and messaging.

costBands.includes: One document set, staff or website users, citations, admin to update documents
Website and WhatsApp, human handover, CRM logging, order or booking lookups
Takes actions in your systems with limits, approvals and audit logs

dataPoints.label: Running costs
dataPoints.value: Model usage per conversation plus WhatsApp message charges and hosting

dataPoints.label: Accuracy levers
dataPoints.value: Clean source documents, retrieval quality, citations, tested question sets

dataPoints.label: Languages
dataPoints.value: English, Hindi and mixed Hindi-English are practical today

dataPoints.label: Must-have
dataPoints.value: Easy route to a person and conversation logs

body:
## What moves the price

- Number and messiness of source documents.
- Channels: website, WhatsApp, internal tools.
- Integrations that let the bot look up orders, bookings or records.
- Testing and accuracy targets.

See [how to build an AI chatbot on your company documents](/blog/how-to-build-an-ai-chatbot-trained-on-your-company-documents) and [what it costs to build an LLM application in India](/blog/what-it-costs-to-build-an-llm-powered-application-in-india).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Can we try it before a full build?
faqs.a: Yes. A four-week proof of concept on real questions shows the accuracy you can expect.
Grounding in your documents, citations and permission to say "I don't know" keep errors rare and visible.
